title: KisanRate: Mandi Crop-Price Tracker
context: Farmers check mandi prices on phones before deciding when and where to sell. Price trends and the best selling day matter.
input: Daily modal prices per crop per mandi; truck loads.

milestones.title: Most traded crop
milestones.requirement: Arrivals per crop id with a count array.

milestones.title: Load a truck
milestones.requirement: Bags whose weights fill a 1 000 kg truck as fully as possible (subset sum).

milestones.title: Merge two mandis
milestones.requirement: Merge two date-sorted price lists into one timeline.

milestones.title: Price on a date
milestones.requirement: Find a date in the sorted list (lower bound).
